features.name: f5_f6_ratio
features.description: Ratio of f5 to f6, smoothed by adding 1 to the denominator to prevent division by zero. Useful for capturing relative magnitude between these two features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a non-linear interaction term that can be linearly separated by SVMs, highlighting proportional differences.

features.name: f7_f8_diff
features.description: Direct difference between f7 and f8.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a linear projection of two related features, directly usable by linear SVM margins.

features.name: f9_log
features.description: Log-transformed value of f9 to compress its scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths the distribution of f9, making it more robust to outliers and improving linear separability.

features.name: f13_f14_sum
features.description: Sum of f13 and f14, representing a combined magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates related features into a single continuous measure, reducing dimensionality for the linear model.

features.name: f15_f16_max
features.description: Maximum value between f15 and f16.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the peak signal across two features, providing a strong continuous feature for margin boundaries.

features.name: f17_f18_diff_abs
features.description: Absolute difference between f17 and f18.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the magnitude of divergence between two features regardless of direction, useful for anomaly detection within linear models.

features.name: f19_f20_ratio
features.description: Ratio of f19 to f20, smoothed by adding 1 to the denominator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes proportional relationships that might be obscured by raw magnitudes, aiding linear decision boundaries.

features.name: f5_to_f9_mean
features.description: Average of features f5 through f9.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stable, low-variance composite feature that summarizes a block of related variables.

features.name: f13_to_f18_mean
features.description: Average of features f13 through f18.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smoothed continuous severity measure across a block of features, ideal for linear SVM weights.

features.name: overall_f5_f9_severity
features.description: Semantic assessment of the overall severity or intensity represented by the block of features f5 through f9.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates raw numerical blocks into a normalized semantic score, providing a smooth feature for linear margins.

features.name: f13_f18_anomaly_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of the anomaly level present in the values of features f13 through f18.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear anomalous patterns as a single continuous score, making them accessible to a linear model.

features.name: f19_f33_activity_level
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the general activity or presence level across the sparse features f19 through f33.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes a large block of sparse features into a dense, continuous activity metric, improving SVM convergence and margin stability.
